name: Vikunja Projects
author: sjwasko
description: Your Vikunja todos in the bar, as a collapsible project tree or one chosen project.

barWidget.description: Shows your next todo in the bar and your projects, nested and collapsible, on click

schema.label: Instance URL
schema.description: Base URL of your Vikunja instance, e.g. https://vikunja.example.com

schema.label: View
schema.description: tree: every project as a collapsible tree. project: only the chosen project. dates: one flat list grouped by due date.

schema.label: Project id
schema.description: The project shown in "One project" view. Easier to pick from the panel's settings page.

schema.label: Include sub-projects
schema.description: In "One project" view, also show todos from projects nested inside it.

schema.label: Hide empty projects
schema.description: In the project tree, leave out projects with no open todos anywhere inside them.

schema.label: Show todos without a due date
schema.description: Include tasks that have no due date.

schema.label: Show next task title in the bar
schema.description: Display the next task's title in the bar; when off, only a compact icon is shown.

schema.label: Sync interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the todo list refreshes automatically.

schema.label: Bar icon
schema.description: mono: the Vikunja llama in your theme's bar color. color: the official blue Vikunja logo.
